title: Koji and Shoyu Pasties
description: Vegan pasties made with koji and shoyu for a unique flavor. Perfect as a snack or dessert.

ingredients.name: Koji
ingredients.notes: Available at health food stores or online

ingredients.name: British mushrooms
ingredients.notes: Substitute with other varieties if needed

instructions: Roll out the pastry dough and cut into circles.
In a pan, sauté the mushrooms and koji in shoyu until fragrant.
Place a spoonful of the mushroom mixture onto one half of the pastry circle.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling and seal the edges.
Bake the pasties for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
